claim: 12TB CMR HDD 方案的 RTO 代价 C_RTO_Balanced = (L_hourly * T_rebuild_Balanced + C_expedited) * P_failure_yearly，假设 L_hourly = ¥1,000/h，C_expedited = ¥5,000，P_failure_yearly = 0.05，则 C_RTO_Balanced ≈ (1000 * 98.8 + 5000) * 0.05 ≈ ¥5,190/年，比 16TB CMR 方案高 19.4%。
